remarks: Nestled within the highly sought-after community of West Irvine Pointe, 62 Cliffwood is a beautifully maintained, move-in-ready home proudly offered by its Original Owner. The thoughtfully designed floor plan features four bedrooms upstairs (with the fourth bedroom currently configured as a library), 2.5 baths, and a 2-car attached garage with a driveway. Step inside to a light-filled interior showcasing a living room with plantation shutters and a spacious family room complete with a fireplace, recessed lighting, built-in entertainment center and built-in speakers for full surround sound!
